log(λi)=β0+Si
Yi∼Poisson(birthsiλi)

```{r}
library(CARBayes)
library(sf)
library(spdep)
library(dplyr)
library(writexl)
library(stringr)
library(ggplot2)

lad_model <- lad_data %>%
  left_join(final, by = c("LAD24CD" = "area_code"))

lad_model <- lad_model %>%
  rename(
    stillbirths = stillbirths.x,
    births = births.x
  )

# England model data
england_sf <- lad_model %>%
  filter(
    !is.na(stillbirths),
    !is.na(births),
    births > 0,
    str_detect(LAD24CD, "^E")
  )

england_sf <- england_sf[card(poly2nb(england_sf, queen = TRUE)) > 0, ]

england_data <- england_sf %>%
  st_drop_geometry()

england_nb <- poly2nb(england_sf, queen = TRUE)

england_W <- listw2mat(nb2listw(england_nb, style = "B"))
england_W <- (england_W + t(england_W)) / 2
england_W <- ifelse(england_W > 0, 1, 0)

england_model_null <- S.CARleroux(
  formula = stillbirths ~ offset(log(births)),
  family = "poisson",
  data = england_data,
  W = england_W,
  burnin = 10000,
  n.sample = 50000
)

# Regression coefficients
results <- england_model_null$summary.results %>%
  as.data.frame() %>%
  mutate(
    parameter = rownames(.),
    model = "England (Null model)"
  )

# Spatial correlation
spatial_results <- data.frame(
  model = "England (Null model)",
  spatial_correlation = england_model_null$summary.results["rho", "Mean"]
)

# Unexplained spatial variance
variance_results <- data.frame(
  model = "England (Null model)",
  unexplained_variance = var(as.vector(england_model_null$samples$phi))
)

CARBayes_results <- list(
  regression_coefficients = results,
  spatial_correlation = spatial_results,
  unexplained_variance = variance_results
)

write_xlsx(
  CARBayes_results,
  file.path(folder, "CARBayes_null_model_results.xlsx")
)

# Predicted stillbirth counts
england_data$predicted_stillbirths <- england_model_null$fitted.values

# Observed vs predicted plot
observed_predicted_plot <- ggplot(
  england_data,
  aes(x = predicted_stillbirths, y = stillbirths)
) +
  geom_point(colour = "steelblue", alpha = 0.7, size = 2) +
  geom_abline(
    intercept = 0,
    slope = 1,
    colour = "red",
    linetype = "dashed"
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "Observed vs Predicted Stillbirth Counts (Null Spatial Model)",
    x = "Predicted stillbirths",
    y = "Observed stillbirths"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()

ggsave(
  file.path(folder, "observed_vs_predicted_null_model.png"),
  observed_predicted_plot,
  width = 7,
  height = 5,
  dpi = 300
)

observed_predicted_plot
```

```{r}
library(CARBayes)
library(spdep)
library(writexl)

n <- nrow(england_sf)

observed <- england_data$stillbirths
predicted <- numeric(n)

for(i in 1:n){

  # Remove left-out LAD
  train_sf <- england_sf[-i, ]
  train_data <- england_data[-i, ]

  # Create neighbours
  nb_train <- poly2nb(train_sf, queen = TRUE)

  # Remove isolated areas
  keep <- card(nb_train) > 0

  train_sf <- train_sf[keep, ]
  train_data <- train_data[keep, ]

  # Recalculate neighbours
  nb_train <- poly2nb(train_sf, queen = TRUE)

  # Spatial weights
  W_train <- listw2mat(
    nb2listw(
      nb_train,
      style = "B",
      zero.policy = TRUE
    )
  )

  W_train <- (W_train + t(W_train)) / 2
  W_train <- ifelse(W_train > 0, 1, 0)

  # Fit null spatial model
  model <- S.CARleroux(
    formula =
      stillbirths ~
      offset(log(births)),
    family = "poisson",
    data = train_data,
    W = W_train,
    burnin = 10000,
    n.sample = 50000
  )

  # Posterior mean intercept
  beta_mean <- mean(model$samples$beta[,1])

  # Predict excluded LAD
  eta <-
    beta_mean +
    log(england_data$births[i])

  predicted[i] <- exp(eta)

}

# Performance metrics

rmse <- sqrt(mean((observed - predicted)^2))

bias <- mean(predicted - observed)

results <- data.frame(
  LAD = england_data$LAD24CD,
  observed = observed,
  predicted = predicted,
  error = predicted - observed
)

print(rmse)
print(bias)

write_xlsx(
  list(
    predictions = results,
    validation = data.frame(
      RMSE = rmse,
      Bias = bias
    )
  ),
  file.path(folder, "LOOCV_null_model.xlsx")
)
```
